settings.heading: We stripped skincare back to honest food.
settings.content:
Hide & Honey started in a farmhouse kitchen, a slow cooker, and a stubborn question: why does skincare need thirty ingredients you can't pronounce?

Our founder grew up on a cattle farm where nothing went to waste. Grandma rendered tallow on the stove and rubbed it into chapped hands all winter. It just worked. Years later, staring at a shelf of half-used creams, that memory came back — so we went to the kitchen and made something simpler.

Four ingredients. Nothing else. We've never seen a reason to add a fifth.

settings.name: Real food
settings.text: If we wouldn't eat it, it doesn't go on skin.

settings.name: Whole-animal
settings.text: A byproduct of regenerative farms — nothing wasted.

settings.name: Small batches
settings.text: Whipped in small runs for freshness.

settings.name: Radical honesty
settings.text: The whole formula is on the front of the jar.
